entities.summary: Domingo Salvador Castagna is an Argentine Roman Catholic prelate, who served as archbishop of Corrientes from 1994 to 2007. He previously served as bishop of San Nicolás de los Arroyos from 1984 to 1994 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Buenos Aires from 1978 to 1984.
